documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Spring check-in, first in-person visit since September.

Doing well. Crohn disease quiet: one to two normal BMs a day, no blood, no cramping, no bloating or vomiting since last May's admission. No skin nodules. Infliximab every 6 weeks at the GI infusion center (last one 3 weeks ago), mesalamine three times a day, iron and B12 daily - occasionally forgets the midday mesalamine. GI visit planned for May. Energy good; teaching a spring mural project. Still not smoking.

Meds: infliximab 5 mg/kg IV q6 weeks (GI), mesalamine DR 800 mg TID, ferrous sulfate 325 mg daily, cyanocobalamin 1000 mcg daily. Allergies: none known.

Exam: vitals as charted. Well. Conjunctivae pink. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nondistended, nontender, normal bowel sounds. Shins clear. No edema.

Assessment/Plan:
1. Crohn disease, quiet on infliximab and mesalamine; prior ileal stricture without symptoms. Continue per GI.
2. Iron deficiency anemia - CBC, iron studies today; continue ferrous sulfate.
3. Dietary B12 deficiency - B12 today; continue.
4. On infliximab - CMP today. Flu and COVID again in the fall; Tdap due this year, will give at the September visit.
Return in September.

documents.title: Your labs from Monday
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Deborah - all good: hemoglobin normal, iron stores healthy, B12 healthy, kidney and liver tests normal. Same plan. See you in September.
